why: An arXiv preprint from September 2026 claims to disprove the general conjecture with a 30-dimensional piecewise-quadratic counterexample on symmetric 5x5 matrix pairs, reportedly found with multi-agent AI assistance; a July 2025 preprint separately proved the conjecture true for the spline (hyperplane-partition) case.

found.title: Pierce-Birkhoff conjecture is false
found.note: Preprint claiming a counterexample disproving the general conjecture; not read.

found.title: Pierce-Birkhoff conjecture is true for splines
found.note: Preprint proving the conjecture for the spline (hyperplane-partition) special case; not read.
